goal: The template defines fixed visual/audio personality. These slots describe variable football media only and are not stored with the template in the Asset Library.
resolution_rule: Resolve the two match-visual alternatives as a group: use one approved real visual only when it materially explains the point; otherwise use the authored pitch-board inside this package.
approval_rule: A discovery candidate is not an asset selection. The channel owner chooses whether it may be saved and whether it may be used for the stated content.

slots.context_rule: Exact fixture, player, or play under discussion. Never substitute a visually similar but unrelated match.
Exact match moment and timestamp. Do not use unlicensed broadcast footage.
Must depict the named player and be current enough for the content context.
slots.fallback: name and role shown as typography; do not synthesize a likeness
